HAIN.text: Hain Celestial has dismissed its CEO and launched a strategic review; management trimmed its fiscal outlook (organic revenue guided to roughly -7% to -8%) citing SKU-simplification and snacks-divestiture headwinds, and formal FY27 guidance is deferred until the review concludes. Barclays had earlier cut the stock to Underweight. The ~49% weekly fall on a 954% volume spike points to a fresh negative catalyst around earnings/guidance.

NBIS.text: Nvidia disclosed a ~9.3% stake in Nebius (tied to a $2B AI-infrastructure investment) and the stock joined the Nasdaq-100 in June 2026. Shares have been highly volatile and well off their mid-2026 highs; the current pullback comes on a large (~172%) volume spike.

LNZA.text: LanzaTech recently secured a ~$40M preferred-stock agreement after an earlier ~$20M registered direct offering; dilutive raises have pressured the shares, which trade far below their 52-week range high.

BYND.text: Beyond Meat posted soft results and guided Q2 revenue below consensus; it briefly traded as a meme stock in October 2026. Analysts still model a revenue decline into 2027.

XIACY.text: Xiaomi (ADR) has rallied on strong EV momentum (outselling Tesla in parts of China) and index inclusion; this week's ~15% ADR gain extends a strong year-to-date run.

AAOI.text: Applied Optoelectronics has been volatile around its optical-networking/AI demand narrative, with several sharp single-day moves after its most recent quarterly report; shares are down from a mid-2026 52-week high near $233.

SIDU.text: Sidus Space was named a contract awardee under the Missile Defense Agency SHIELD program (Golden Dome initiative) in late 2025; the micro-cap remains highly volatile with no confirmed fresh catalyst for the current slide.
